title: Red Dead Redemption 2

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · Rockstar Games build
custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Red Dead Redemption 2 as a digital open-world holding.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and Rockstar launcher / online services where the client requires them.
preservation.concerns: Account-bound digital holdings face platform dependency and policy change. Multiplayer components and third-party launcher requirements increase long-term access risk. No physical disc or offline installer is held for this filing.
preservation.knownRevisions: Console release preceded the PC edition. Steam storefront date for this PC edition is December 5, 2019. This accession records the licensed digital edition in custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and the required services remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.
